title: waits_on for a dead run and the per-checkout liveness answer: the listing surface needs one probing convention
body: status's liveness (and therefore the model's dead-run wait) is per-checkout: a run whose pidfile lives in the repo it works in reads dead-run from anywhere else. Correct for `status <run-id>` (the model is a snapshot of what this checkout can read), but `ticfac` with no arguments (2qz) will list runs from multiple checkouts and needs one convention for where each run is probed — the run-state store's origin view or a per-run registration of the working repo. Worth deciding before 2qz builds its listing.
